notes: MAC Aura XB is a compact LED moving-head wash fixture (not a traditional AV rack device), so category/type were mapped to the closest available options ("other"/"Other"). Not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted). No Ethernet/network, video, or audio connectors on this fixture — it is DMX/RDM controlled only, confirmed via the dedicated power-connections page (https://www.martin.com/en-US/power-connections-for-mac-aura-xb) which lists Power In (NAC3FX-W) and Power Out/Thru (NAC3MX-W) powerCON TRUE1 connectors. No grade fields set since PowerCON and 5-pin XLR/DMX are not in the graded connector families (SDI/HDMI/DP/USB/Ethernet).

ports.name: Power Out/Thru
ports.note: Neutrik powerCON TRUE1, NAC3MX-W; power relay for daisy-chaining fixtures

ports.name: DMX Thru
ports.note: 5-pin locking XLR, DMX/RDM pass-through to next fixture
